name: BoostHook leveraged longs financed at a manipulable spot price
summary: BoostHook's openLong lends ETH from the hook's own Uniswap v4 liquidity bands and spends collateral plus loan on BOOST at the pool's instantaneous price, with caller-set slippage. The attacker bought BOOST, opened 5x longs that pumped the price with band ETH, then sold its BOOST into the pumped pool, leaving the longs insolvent.
notes: Loss is the ETH the pool's bands lost in the PoolManager per transaction. The 1% swap and borrow fees the hook credited to the team fee recipient and BoostStaking are not subtracted (rule 14); BOOST moved from the pool into the hook's position holdings stays in protocol custody and is not counted.

Campaign: the four later contract txs that buy BOOST, call openLong and sell within one transaction (copycats incl. c0ffeebabe); all earlier openLong calls come straight from EOAs as ordinary trades. Later owner calls only seeded bands and set staking, gates and liquidity, not resets.
